description: This Java interface defines a factory for creating command consumers and command response senders within the Eclipse Hono client, specifically for handling AMQP 1.0 messaging network commands and responses.

classes.name: CommandConsumerFactory
classes.description: A factory interface for creating command consumers and command response senders in the Hono client.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new factory instance for an existing connection.

methods.name: createCommandConsumer
methods.description: Creates a command consumer for a device, with various overloads for different parameters including gateway ID and liveness check interval.

methods.name: getCommandResponseSender
methods.description: Obtains a sender for command responses to a tenant, using a reply ID.

methods.name: getLegacyCommandResponseSender
methods.description: Deprecated method for obtaining a command response sender using legacy address pattern.
